currency_note: Bolívar Fuerte (VEF) until Aug 2018; Bolívar Soberano (VES) from Aug 2018 — FX series switches currency in 2018.

sources.population: IMF World Economic Outlook LP via DataMapper, Oct 2026 vintage (millions converted to persons; World Bank unavailable)
sources.fx_rate: No data available from World Bank or ECB

fx_definition: Annual average units of local currency per 1 US dollar (calendar-year basis, Dec 31 year-end convention)
news_note: 2-3 major geopolitical events per year, editorial selection, one-line summaries
sport_note: One notable sporting event per year involving the country, editorial selection

geopolitical_news.headline: Chávez re-elected president
geopolitical_news.summary: He wins December's vote with a wide margin on high oil prices.

geopolitical_news.headline: RCTV closure announced
geopolitical_news.summary: Chávez declares the opposition channel's license will not be renewed.

sport.headline: Venezuela misses the World Cup
sport.summary: A last-place qualifying finish keeps Venezuela out of Germany 2006.

geopolitical_news.headline: RCTV taken off air
geopolitical_news.summary: The May shutdown of the critical broadcaster sparks mass protests.

geopolitical_news.headline: Constitutional referendum defeated
geopolitical_news.summary: Voters narrowly reject Chávez's socialist charter reform in December.

sport.headline: Copa América hosts reach quarter-finals
sport.summary: Venezuela enjoys its best ever tournament on home soil.

geopolitical_news.headline: Banking nationalizations
geopolitical_news.summary: Chávez seizes major banks and cement firms amid the global crisis.

geopolitical_news.headline: Regional elections setback
geopolitical_news.summary: The opposition wins key states including Miranda in November.

sport.headline: World Cup qualifying struggles
sport.summary: Venezuela sits mid-table in the race for South Africa 2010.

geopolitical_news.headline: Term limits abolished
geopolitical_news.summary: Voters approve indefinite presidential re-election in a February referendum, letting Chávez run again.

geopolitical_news.headline: Colombia bases row
geopolitical_news.summary: Chávez freezes ties with Bogotá over its US military pact.

sport.headline: Venezuela misses South Africa 2010
sport.summary: An eighth-place finish in CONMEBOL qualifying ends Venezuela's South Africa 2010 hopes.

geopolitical_news.headline: Opposition gains in parliament
geopolitical_news.summary: The MUD wins the popular vote in September but fewer seats.

geopolitical_news.headline: Power crisis blackouts
geopolitical_news.summary: Severe drought cripples the giant Guri hydroelectric dam, forcing nationwide electricity rationing measures.

sport.headline: No World Cup for Venezuela
sport.summary: Venezuela watches the South Africa 2010 World Cup from home after qualifying eighth.

geopolitical_news.headline: Chávez reveals cancer
geopolitical_news.summary: He announces in June he is being treated in Cuba, shaking the nation.

geopolitical_news.headline: Crime wave worsens
geopolitical_news.summary: Homicides soar as insecurity becomes the top public concern.

sport.headline: Best Copa América ever
sport.summary: Venezuela reaches the semi-finals in Argentina, finishing fourth for its best-ever Copa América.

geopolitical_news.headline: Chávez re-elected
geopolitical_news.summary: He beats Henrique Capriles in October despite his illness.

geopolitical_news.headline: Cancer returns
geopolitical_news.summary: Chávez announces a relapse in December and names Maduro his successor.

sport.headline: World Cup qualifying push
sport.summary: Venezuela contends for Brazil 2014 into the final rounds.

geopolitical_news.headline: Chávez dies
geopolitical_news.summary: The president dies of cancer on March 5 after 14 years in power.

geopolitical_news.headline: Maduro wins disputed election
geopolitical_news.summary: He edges Capriles in April amid opposition fraud claims.

sport.headline: Venezuela misses Brazil 2014
sport.summary: A sixth-place finish ends the closest qualifying campaign yet.

geopolitical_news.headline: Mass protests erupt
geopolitical_news.summary: February demonstrations over shortages and crime leave dozens dead.

geopolitical_news.headline: López jailed
geopolitical_news.summary: Opposition leader Leopoldo López is imprisoned after leading the protests.

sport.headline: No World Cup for Venezuela
sport.summary: Venezuela watches the Brazil 2014 World Cup from home after finishing sixth.

geopolitical_news.headline: Opposition wins parliament
geopolitical_news.summary: The MUD takes a supermajority in December's legislative elections.

geopolitical_news.headline: Border closed with Colombia
geopolitical_news.summary: Maduro shuts the frontier and deports thousands in August.

sport.headline: Copa América group-stage exit
sport.summary: Venezuela goes out early in Chile following a deeply disappointing Copa América group-stage campaign.

geopolitical_news.headline: Recall referendum blocked
geopolitical_news.summary: Electoral authorities stymie the opposition's recall-referendum drive to remove President Maduro from office.

geopolitical_news.headline: Economic collapse deepens
geopolitical_news.summary: Triple-digit inflation and chronic food and medicine shortages immiserate millions of Venezuelans nationwide.

sport.headline: Copa América quarter-final run
sport.summary: Venezuela reaches the Copa América Centenario knockouts in the United States with surprising flair.

geopolitical_news.headline: Constituent assembly imposed
geopolitical_news.summary: Maduro installs an all-powerful body in July after a boycotted vote.

geopolitical_news.headline: Deadly protest crackdown
geopolitical_news.summary: Months of demonstrations leave well over a hundred dead.

sport.headline: Under-20 World Cup final
sport.summary: Venezuela loses the final to England, its greatest football achievement.

geopolitical_news.headline: Maduro re-elected in boycotted vote
geopolitical_news.summary: He claims victory in May as the opposition and many nations reject the poll.

geopolitical_news.headline: Drone attack on Maduro
geopolitical_news.summary: Explosives detonate during a military parade in August; he blames Colombia.

sport.headline: Venezuela misses Russia 2018
sport.summary: A last-place CONMEBOL qualifying campaign ends Venezuela's Russia 2018 hopes long before the finish.

geopolitical_news.headline: Guaidó claims interim presidency
geopolitical_news.summary: The assembly leader is recognized by dozens of countries in January.

geopolitical_news.headline: Blackouts paralyze country
geopolitical_news.summary: March power failures leave millions in the dark for days.

geopolitical_news.headline: Failed uprising in April
geopolitical_news.summary: Guaidó's call for military rebellion fizzles on April 30.

sport.headline: Copa América quarter-final run
sport.summary: Venezuela reaches the Copa América knockouts in Brazil after an unbeaten group stage.

geopolitical_news.headline: Guaidó's momentum fades
geopolitical_news.summary: The opposition's interim government loses steam and territorial control.

geopolitical_news.headline: Boycotted parliament vote
geopolitical_news.summary: The ruling party sweeps December elections the opposition shuns.

sport.headline: Football halted by pandemic
sport.summary: World Cup qualifiers stop for months; Venezuela resumes with three straight heavy defeats.

geopolitical_news.headline: Regional elections held
geopolitical_news.summary: The opposition returns to the ballot box in November with modest gains.

geopolitical_news.headline: Alex Saab extradited to US
geopolitical_news.summary: Maduro's alleged frontman is sent to Miami in October.

sport.headline: Copa América group-stage exit
sport.summary: Venezuela goes out winless in Brazil after a COVID-depleted squad limps through the tournament.

geopolitical_news.headline: US oil talks resume
geopolitical_news.summary: Washington eases some sanctions and negotiates with Caracas after Ukraine's invasion.

geopolitical_news.headline: Migration exodus grows
geopolitical_news.summary: Millions of Venezuelans flee the deepening crisis, straining Colombia's and the region's resources.

sport.headline: Venezuela misses Qatar 2022
sport.summary: A last-place CONMEBOL qualifying finish ends Venezuela's Qatar 2022 hopes well before the end.

geopolitical_news.headline: Essequibo referendum held
geopolitical_news.summary: Caracas stages a December vote claiming Guyana's disputed region.

geopolitical_news.headline: Barbados deal and sanctions relief
geopolitical_news.summary: A pact promises fairer elections; Washington eases oil sanctions, then reimposes them.

sport.headline: Strong start to 2026 qualifying
sport.summary: Under coach Fernando Batista, Venezuela opens the 2026 World Cup qualifying campaign unbeaten.

geopolitical_news.headline: Maduro claims re-election
geopolitical_news.summary: Authorities declare victory in July's vote; tallies published by the opposition suggest fraud.

geopolitical_news.headline: González flees to Spain
geopolitical_news.summary: Opposition candidate Edmundo González seeks asylum in September amid arrest threats.

sport.headline: Copa América quarter-final run
sport.summary: Venezuela wins all three group games before losing to Canada.

geopolitical_news.headline: Machado wins Nobel Peace Prize
geopolitical_news.summary: María Corina Machado receives the October prize for her democratic struggle.

geopolitical_news.headline: US strikes alleged drug boats
geopolitical_news.summary: American forces hit vessels in the Caribbean from September amid a military buildup.

sport.headline: Venezuela misses 2026 World Cup
sport.summary: A late qualifying collapse ends the dream of a first finals appearance.
